values.task_boundary: Bring #341 to reviewable publication-ready PR state for provider-neutral proof and private Observatory demonstration; stop before merge unless separately authorized.
deliverables: redacted provider receipts and artifact digests under .csdlc/evidence/341
private Observatory demo evidence showing several agents running
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: At least two approved real providers complete the identical versioned scenario through equivalent ACIP operations.
AC-2: Provider identity/capability truth and bounded semantic differences are retained without credentials, private prompts, or private payloads.
AC-3: Malformed, denied, interrupted, unavailable, provider-loss, and substitution cases have visible non-pass outcomes.
AC-4: One provider failure leaves Runtime and unrelated agents available, with macOS/Linux tooling posture recorded.
AC-5: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding.
AC-6: A private Observatory demonstration shows several agents running after proof success, without claiming public exposure or production deployment.
